cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.32% · WTI -5.60% · Brent -0.58% · NatGas -2.13%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.18%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.18%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.94%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +10.23%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +10.23%, ENPH +4.41%, SEDG +4.35%, ARRY +3.53%, WFRD +2.52%. Laggards: EOSE -4.97%, PWR -3.03%, ETN -2.34%, BE -1.72%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
